<div class="section-intro">
Projects is the development layer of this website: active or planned research that is not yet represented by a formal publication. Private manuscript repositories can be represented here without exposing their code, data, model files, or development history.
</div>

{{< include _generated.md >}}

::: {.qs-footnote-note}
**Project logo rule.** Project cards are generated from `projects/registry.json`. When a source repository contains its canonical `assets/images/logo.svg` or `assets/images/logo.png`, the weekly synchronization mirrors that exact file into `images/projects/` and the card displays it automatically. If the canonical logo does not exist or the source repository cannot be read, the visual slot remains empty; substitute or invented logos are never used.
:::
